Photograph of the white-border [[Moving To Attack Position (Revised)]] card published by [[Decipher]]. The linked source retains the whole obtained photograph; its photographer is not identified.

== Source ==
* Physical white-border face: [https://i.ebayimg.com/images/g/8vQAAOSwbN5lxcpA/s-l1600.webp complete source photograph].

== Preparation ==
The complete 1200 × 1600-pixel source is retained unchanged. Rectangle (295, 380)–(995, 1230) was extracted with right and bottom coordinates exclusive and downsampled using Lanczos resampling to 350 × 425 pixels, then saved as PNG. Printed words, art, icons and borders were not repainted or reconstructed. This is a photographic crop, not a facsimile. Photograph or acquisition dates do not establish first publication.

== Preservation ==
Wayback copy of this exact original (SHA-256 verified by the central preservation owner): [https://web.archive.org/web/20261120195400/https://swccg.com/wiki/images/1/15/Dagobah-Revised-L-movingtoattackposition-physical-photo.png Internet Archive].
